result.title: Free to Look, Free to Reason: Simple LLM Harnesses Outdiagnose Hand-Crafted Root Cause Analysis Agents
result.summary: Root cause analysis (RCA) of microservice failures has attracted many LLM agents whose investigation is hand-crafted, through standard operating procedures, fixed stages and role agents. Each is evaluated on its own data against few baselines, so it is unknown whether this design beats letting a capable model investigate on its own. We compare three simple harnesses that prescribe none of the model's calls (one call over an evidence package, a SQL agent and the Codex coding agent) with five published LLM RCA agents and with statistical and causal methods on RCAtlas, 90 validated cases from eight public datasets, across six models and three reasoning efforts. The simple harnesses are the most accurate (PR@1 65-77% on three mid-tier models), ahead of the published agents (16-53%) and the non-LLM methods (6-39%), on every model on which both families were run. The published agents fix from a tenth to all of their model calls in the program, and a case study shows how these prescriptions skip the decisive evidence. A stronger model mainly improves reliability, a multi-turn harness mainly improves aptitude, and more reasoning effort changes accuracy by a few points at most while multiplying the time by up to seven. Among runs more accurate than the best non-LLM method, every Pareto-optimal run in cost or time uses a simple harness.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在 90 个经校验的微服务故障案例上，比较三种不预设模型调用的简单 harness（单次调用证据包、SQL agent、Codex 编码 agent）与五个已发表 LLM RCA agent 及统计/因果方法，并考察模型强度、多轮与推理努力对准确率和耗时的影响。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「固定阶段与角色预设会跳过决定性证据」以及「提高推理努力只换来数个百分点却成倍增加时间」的结论，可能为 LVR 中 LOOK/STOP 决策与推理预算分配提供可核查的对照线索，但属非视觉的文本 RCA 设定，迁移需进一步判断。
